notes.title: Patch 0.40.0 - Opening up the playtest!
notes.notes:
Hello, Feur Gamers! With this patch the game is now available in the Steam Store directly, making it easier for people to find it! Keys are no longer needed.
The game now also includes a link to the discord!

This patch comes with a brand new game mode, a rework on how token effects are processed, as well as a LOT of QoL changes.

Have fun, and keep on feuring!

[b]Patch 0.40.0[/b]
[b]- New game mode: Arcade![/b]
[list]
	- Defend yourself against a horde of grey tokens.
	- Make your spells strongers through augments!
	- Get high scores!
[/list]
[b]- Gameplay[/b]
[list]
	- Token status effect durations now tick down at the end of every turn (as opposed to their owner turn).
	- This is not done on the first turn they're applied.
	- Adjusted duration values to compensate.
	- Standardized rules for stacking effects:[list]
		- Only one effect of the same name may be applied on a token.
		- If they can stack (e.g alchemist cooking) the stacks are added.
		- If they have a duration, longest duration stays.
[/list]
	- Effects are once again applied at the end of the turn (instead of at the beginning of the next one).
[/list]
[b]- Classes[/b]
[list]
	[i]- Cleric[/i]
[list]
		- Tokens are now immediately converted on reaching 3 stacks.
		- Remove Holy Cross starting cooldown.
		- Holy Cross *Return* tokens time to arrive: 1 -> 3. 
[/list]

	[i]- Lawyer[/i][list]
		- *Damning evidence* duration: 3 -> 5.
		- *Restraining order* duration: 2 -> 5.
		- *Restraining order* cooldown: 3 -> 4. [/list]

	[i]- Warrior[/i] [list]
		- *Wake Up DP* tokens renamed to Mashing.
		- *Wake Up DP* duration: 5 -> 6.
		- *Wake Up DP* cooldown: 5 -> 4.
		- *Wake Up DP* tokens now turn around after each DP. [/list]
[/list]

[b]- Misc[/b]
[list]
	- Left click on tutorial dialogue now makes the text display faster.
	- Cleaned up slot tooltips.
	- Various hazard animation changes.
	- Added visuals to display effect stack number.
	- Added a sound before every ult animation.
	- Fixed a bug where the puzzle music would be playing in puzzle creation mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.39.0: Menus, Killcam fixes and WAKE UP DP
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585385/7287b21d6f0a68cfac84545fe1d516ba40829443.png"][/img][/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][p]	- Buffed DIAGONAL hazards (Bishop), now grants +100 points.[/p][h1]Classes[/h1][h2]Cleric[/h2][p]	- *Healing* now requires a friendly token to be put down.[/p][p]	- *Healing* cooldown: 5 -> 4.[/p][h2]Cryptomancers[/h2][p]	- Encryption duration: 3 -> 4 .[/p][p]	- Encrption cooldown: 3 -> 4.[/p][p]	- Alice and Bob tokens now check for the shortest path instead of the longest.[/p][p]	- Doubled meter gain (10 per distance).[/p][p]	- Connecting an Alice and a Bob token now grants an extra turn if the path was at least 4 tokens long.[/p][p]	- Side Channel Attack: Now summons bombs :)[/p][h2]Lawyer[/h2][p]	- Performing a connect 4 using a *CONNECT THREE* token now gives 150 points (from 100).[/p][p]	- Destroying a token using a *RESTRAINING ORDER* token now gives 25 points.[/p][h2]Warrior[/h2][p]	- Removed Uppercut.[/p][p]	- New spell: Wake up DP.[/p][p]		- Puts a *MADMAN* token, which punches the token they're facing upwards at the beginning of your turn. Grants meter.[/p][p]	- EX Uppercut (Berserk version) is unchanged.[/p][p][/p][h1]Misc[/h1][p]	- Made ENCRYPTED tooltip clearer about their duration.[/p][p]	- Added intro screen.[/p][p]	- Names are now clipped after 14 characters in game (they wont go outside the screen).[/p][p]	- Removed red arrow on stage hazard spawn.[/p][p]	- Updated main menu look.[/p][p]	- Token effects now have a glow around them depending on their owner.[/p][p]	- 2 status effects can now be displayed at the same time (up from 1).[/p][p]	- Tweaks on full screen vs windowed mode.[/p][p]	- Killcams are back (and should crash less...?)[/p][p]	- Added version number to main menu (now follows the MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH template)[/p][p]	- Pressing "Change characters" on the winning screen no longer requires both players to choose the option (happens immediately).[/p][p]	- Experience is now earned for each character separately.[/p][p]	- Unlocks can now be tied behind character levels.[/p][p]	- Added achievments![/p][p]	- Added tooltip specifying Side Channel attack amount of meters in chaos mode.[/p][p]	- Added tooltip for bomb tokens.[/p][p]	- Removed french translation (for now).[/p][p]	- Fixed minor bug with displaying token effect duration in puzzle mode.[/p]
